Sum of Two-Digit Multiples of 3: Class 10 board exam ka ye AP question dekh ke dar lagta hai? Step by step, with the common trap.

• First term a = 12 (10 and 11 aren't multiples of 3), last term l = 99, d = 3
• The trap: 99 ÷ 3 = 33 also counts 3, 6 and 9
• nth term: 99 = 12 + (n − 1) × 3, so n = 30
• S = 30/2 × (12 + 99) = 15 × 111 = 1665
